name: avenir-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for YNAB: budgets, spending and transaction classification, built for agents.

ynab_token.title: YNAB personal access token
ynab_token.description: In YNAB, open Account settings > Developer settings > New Token. The token can read and change every plan of your account: YNAB offers no read-only one. avenir-mcp never logs it and never returns it in an answer.
